2607.12962.title: Form, Not Content? A Preregistered, Placebo-Controlled Evaluation of Learned Error-Conditioned Self-Repair Through Prompts and Weights in Frozen Small Code Models
2607.12962.paper_summary: Frozen small code LLMs are deployed locally, yet the information guiding a retry after a failed attempt is still measured without placebo controls in the self-repair literature. We treat a failed program as a conjecture and an execution counterexample as an oracle-relative refutation, and introduce PoPE (Popperian Placebo-controlled Evaluation): a methodology for measuring whether evidence that falsifies LLM-generated code can be used operationally by that same model. In PoPE, error content is paired with channel-specific placebos that keep the predeclared scaffold while ablating task-relevant content or deranging the task-error assignment. Frozen small code models (0.5-1.5B) are evaluated under preregistered rules through a prompt channel and a weight channel (small-data adapter training), with four generations per arm-unit pair. In the prompt channel, public-tier screening unlocked 12 units under the content-ablated form placebo versus 10 under the live error-pattern arm on a 40-unit resistant band; the result was recorded as mechanism-null. In the weight channel, an 8-8 tie was observed between the error-content adapter and the intervention-free baseline (p=1.0), while the SHA-deranged placebo adapter stayed ahead with 10 unlocks; content-attributable superiority was not confirmed. These results do not constitute evidence of equivalence or non-inferiority. Equivalence was not tested separately. Findings are restricted to the public-tier screening endpoint; hidden-tier confirmation was deferred by design. We read this not as compiled criticism disappearing as information, but as the loss of its external role in testing a new conjecture: when a representation learned from the oracle is written back into the generation state, testing is replaced by conditioning. No working JEPA-RL controller is claimed. PoPE is presented as a placebo-controlled, retestable measurement standard.
2607.12962.paper_summary_zh: 冷凍的小型代碼 LLM 被本地部署，但在自我修復文獻中，指導重試的資訊仍然是在沒有安慰劑對照的情況下進行測量。我們將失敗的程序視為一種猜想，而執行反例則視為相對於神諭的反駁，並引入 PoPE（波普式安慰劑對照評估）：一種測量能否操作性地使用證據來駁斥 LLM 生成代碼的方法。在 PoPE 中，錯誤內容與特定通道的安慰劑配對，保持預先宣告的框架，同時去除與任務相關的內容或擾亂任務錯誤分配。冷凍的小型代碼模型（0.5-1.5B）在預註冊規則下通過提示通道和權重通道（小數據適配器訓練）進行評估，每對臂單元進行四次生成。在提示通道中，公共層篩選在內容去除形式的安慰劑下解鎖了 12 個單元，而在實時錯誤模式臂下則解鎖了 10 個單元，總共在 40 個單元的抗性帶上；結果被記錄為機制無效。在權重通道中，錯誤內容適配器與無干預基線之間觀察到了 8-8 的平局（p=1.0），而 SHA 擾亂的安慰劑適配器則以 10 次解鎖領先；內容可歸因的優越性未被確認。這些結果並不構成等價或非劣證據。等價性未單獨測試。發現僅限於公共層篩選終點；隱藏層確認因設計而延遲。我們將此視為編譯的批評並未隨著資訊消失，而是其在測試新猜想中的外部角色的喪失：當從神諭學到的表示被寫回生成狀態時，測試被條件化所取代。未聲稱有有效的 JEPA-RL 控制器。PoPE 被提出為一種安慰劑對照、可重測的測量標準。
2607.12962.author: Mehmet Iscan et.al.
